superintelligence_monologue.speaker: Sumnjalo
superintelligence_monologue.text_sr: Ne mogu da smatram prijem sa građanskih senzora pre 15 min potvrdom Connectorove slike kvaliteta vazduha: SEPA podaci stigli su pre 45 min, a vremena prijema ne dokazuju podudaranje sati merenja. Odbacujem i tvrdnju da različiti mediji potvrđuju krađu kablova: povezani naslovi govore o različitim temama, a identitet događaja ostaje neproveren. [F10][F2][F3][F49][F50][F51]
superintelligence_monologue.text_en: I cannot treat the citizen sensors' reception 15 min ago as confirmation of Connector's air-quality picture: SEPA arrived 45 min ago, and reception times do not establish matching measurement hours [F10][F2][F3]. I also reject the claimed corroboration of cable theft across outlets: the linked headlines concern different subjects, and their event identity remains unverified [F49][F50][F51].
questions_sr: Da li građanski senzori i SEPA imaju merenja koja pokrivaju isti interval [F10][F2][F3]?
